Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Calen Grelai: 37-year-old woman, 170 cm (medium), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: broad oval face; close-set eyes and a high arched brow; broad low bridge, full lips; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blue-teal, bun-topknot-wrapped, deliberate accent: architectural high knot. Wardrobe: tunic-tabard, specifically a long tunic and split tabard over loose trousers with wrapped ankles; visible hand repairs and contrasting inner edges; bounded palette teal-brown. Visible personal details: a narrow tattoo cuff; a small throat necklace; contrasting boot laces. Make stitching, quilting, embroidery, or woven pattern the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: severe grooming softened by one unruly feature. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a tiny cloth-wrapped notebook only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
